detail.longDescription: Hi all! My name is Jacek Becela, this is my first Show HN. I wanted to create blueprint wallpapers for my desktop and got a bit carried away. These were created along the way: - 42 unique wallpapers, each in 3 color intensity versions, 18 resolutions and aspect ratios giving in total 2268 files (~700MB) served on demand from Cloudflare R2 - the color theme, - music video with two genre options - a companion app for downloading the versions correct for your screen. - a blog post describing the journey I used AI during the whole creative process: Opus 5.5 on medium/high and Suno. Used Suno for the first time and had so much fun! Completely new experience for me. I made almost 500 decisions during the process and I wrote about it here: https://jacekbecela.com/blog/omarchy-p-bloom-theme/ Feedback most welcome!
